Subject: Data control checkpoints + DDQ sprint plan

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Wanted to capture the main pain points we heard, confirm goals, and propose an evidence/engagement timeline so your security and legal teams can plan.

Summary of priorities from today's call:
- SOC 2 evidence & auditor details: FinanceCo needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report and system description, plus confirmation of the auditor and scope (production/e2e).
- Audit log export and format: Requirement for immutable audit logs with at least 13 months retention and an export capability (Parquet preferred).
- Data residency & retention: Primary requirement is US residency (us-east-1) for primary logs and a retention policy that supports 13 months for auditing and 90 days for quick restores.
- DPA & subprocessors: Legal will expect a standard DPA plus a list of subprocessors and our approach to data deletion on contract termination.
- Pen test window and scoping: Need to agree scope (external/internal), rules of engagement, and a 2–4 week testing window.
- Technical controls: SAML SSO, KMS integration for envelope encryption, and audit log schema/field mappings.

Proposed next steps (suggested timeline):
1) Evidence handoff: Redwood to deliver a packaged evidence bundle (SOC 2 report extract, system description, SOC control matrix, audit log schema doc) — target: 2027-05-14. (Owner: Marissa)
2) DPA review: Draft DPA to be shared via DocuSign for FinanceCo legal review — target to share by 2027-05-11.
3) Pen test scoping & window: Redwood to propose scope and a preferred week for pen test; FinanceCo to confirm vendor acceptance — target: scope by 2027-05-12, window by 2027-05-21. (Owner: Evelyn)
4) Audit export sample: Provide a 7-day sample export and schema mapping (Parquet sample) for FinanceCo security to validate — target: 2027-05-12.

Attachments included with this message:
- SOC2-summary-Redwood-2026.pdf (summary, auditor name redacted for initial pass)
- pen-test-scope-template.xlsx (template we typically use to speed alignment)

Open items we need from FinanceCo:
- Security contact and legal reviewer names + preferred DPA redline timeline.
- Confirmation on exact retention window (13 months confirmed on call? please confirm if 395 days required or 395-day exception).
- Any additional compliance criteria (e.g., log format constraints, third-party log aggregator integrations).

I know there are a few moving pieces — happy to run a 30 min evidence-handoff call next week. My team is available Tue/Wed mornings PST and Thursday afternoon PST.

Appreciate the partnership — we'll try to make the evidence packaging as self-serve as possible.

Best,
